mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months signals an active monetary easing cycle, which reduces discount rates for equity valuations and drives positive forward returns in the S&P 500 over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive in periods where FEDFUNDS declines, as measured by a t-test p-value > 0.05, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate above 4.2% over two consecutive months signals weakening labor market conditions, which reduces inflationary pressure and increases the likelihood of future monetary easing, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative or flat 20-day returns in 60% or more of instances where UNRATE exceeds 4.2% for two consecutive months, or the signal's Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in housing starts below 1300 thousand units over two consecutive months signals weakening consumer demand and a contraction in residential investment, which increases the probability of a policy response and triggers positive equity returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the signal's Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in industrial production below 107.0 for two consecutive months indicates a contraction in real economic output, which increases the likelihood of monetary policy accommodation and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive in triggered periods (t-test p > 0.05), or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 3.5% and CPIAUCSL is above 250.0, it indicates a tight monetary policy environment with persistent inflation, which increases the risk of a recession and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: tight monetary policy with high inflation
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the interaction signal's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both residential investment (HOUST) and real personal consumption (RSAFS) signals a broad-based weakening in aggregate demand, which increases the likelihood of fiscal or monetary stimulus and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS fall below thresholds, or the interaction signal's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the unemployment rate above 4.2% combined with a decline in payroll employment below 148,000 thousand signals a labor market slowdown, which increases the probability of policy intervention and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: labor market deterioration with job losses
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive in more than 60% of triggered instances (t-test p > 0.05), or the interaction signal's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: When real GDP growth (GDPC1) is below 1.0% on a year-over-year basis and housing starts (HOUST) are below 1350 thousand, it indicates a stagnating economy with weak demand, which increases the likelihood of stimulus and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the interaction signal's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
